scope: 32-bit absolute-pointer MSVC RTTI in initialized .rdata/.data only

vftables.termination: observed-adjacent-data: ASCII Res followed by PROC

limits: Names are original mangled RTTI strings, not manually renamed functions.
Non-polymorphic/no-RTTI classes and runtime-generated tables can be absent.
Vtable slot extent ends at observed adjacent data or first non-text pointer and is a bounded candidate sequence, not a universal proof of the class virtual-method count.
Subobject offsets and PMD triples describe inheritance adjustment, not complete instance field layouts.
No constructors, destructors or virtual calls were executed.
